(cf. √ मञ्च्) cl. 1. Ā. मचते (pf. मेचे &c.), to cheat, be wicked or arrogant;
to pound, grind, Dhātup. vi, 12.
in comp. for 1. मद्.
prob. w.r. for मेचक-च्˚, q.v.
N. of a Yakṣa and of a sacred spot guarded by him near the entrance to Kuru-kṣetra, MBh. (cf. मङ्कणक).
excellence, anything excellent or good of its kind (cf. गो-म्˚) g. मतल्लिकादि (Gaṇar.)
&c. See under 1. मद्, p. 777, col. 2.
मच्—चित्त mfn. having the mind (fixed) on me, thinking of me, Bhag.
(Prākṛ. for मत्स्य) a fish, L.
marked with a fish-eye (said of a bad pearl), ib.
मच्—छरीर (मद् + शर्˚) n. my body, ib.
मा—चिरम् ind., ‘not long’, shortly, quickly, MBh.; R.; Pur. (generally after an Impv. or augmentless aor., and almost always at the end of a verse; sometimes mc. for न-चिरम्, q.v.)
See under 1. मा, p. 804, col. 2.
a way, road, L. (cf. माठ, माथ).
(perhaps fr. 1. मा + चल) a thief, robber, L.
= ग्राह, or ग्रह, L.
sickness, L. (cf. करि- and गज-म्˚).
See पर्ण-म्˚.
N. of a grammarian, TPrāt.
a fly, L. (cf. गृह-म्˚) Hibiscus Cannabinus, Bhpr. (cf. काक-म्˚).
see काक- and ध्वाङ्क्ष-म्˚.
माची—पत्त्र n. a species of medicinal plant, L. (cf. मञ्चि-प्˚).
